scope: Successful observed method_seconds remain primary. Explicit estimated_method_seconds are declared unmeasured assumptions; missing cases use the conservative fallback. Grouping only: every source-discovered method executes exactly once.
selection_policy: Most recent successful XCTest case completion in runs 62 and 63; run 63 takes precedence. Failed observations do not replace successful or historical weights. Case duration excludes Xcode setup and result finalization; estimates are not process-deadline guarantees.
